chunks: And the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"Indeed, when animals are cursed, the curse clings to them."

key_terms.اَلنَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the speaker of this teaching
key_terms.لَزِمَتْهَا: it adhered to them or remained attached to them
key_terms.لُعِنَتْ: were cursed or subjected to invoking curse upon them

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about cursing animals?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that cursing animals is blameworthy and has a real moral consequence upon them. It reflects the Prophetic صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم ethic of mercy and restraint in speech toward creatures under human care.
